about.title: Our Tale
about.subtitle: The story of how Dungeon Pub was created.
about.p1: If you like fantasy, sci-fi, comics, video games, or board games, you are in the right place.
about.p2: We founded Dungeon Pub in 2015 as a space where people from different geek communities can meet, get to know each other, and have fun. At the same time, Dungeon also functions as a platform for organizing your own themed events – you can hold your own event with us by arrangement with our event team. Just contact us (ideally in person 😉).
about.p3: During the month, you will find a lot of different events with us – from quizzes and game tournaments to stand-up comedy. Check our Facebook page for the current schedule!
about.p4: In addition to events, you will also find a closet full of board games that you can borrow for free.
about.p5: If you prefer video games, we have a PS4 or our arcade machine with hundreds of retro classics for you.
